basis: Dmitry authorized this change over Telegram on 2026-09-24. He was told (29082) that the first critical review of VELDO-0058 found the gate's protected-file check reading its protected list from the change it checks, so a change could empty the list and land an edit to verify.sh with no approval, and asked whether policy_check.py (a protected file) may change so that the list is read from the trusted installed copy instead; he answered 'Yes' (29083). The two paths are the protected_paths this commit changes. What it carries is an explicit POLICY source, separate from the subject root ROOT: unset, a run reads ROOT/.veldo/policy.yaml exactly as before; the installed-policy runner sets it to the installation's policy.yaml. No other policy_check behavior changed.
